tableQuery.query:
select 
  statis_dt as "统计日期"
, store_code as "门店编码"
, store_name as "门店名称"
, extent_type_desc as "推广类型描述"
, attribution_period as "归因周期"
, attribution_model  as "归因模型"
, deliv_type as "投放类型"
, acct_type as "账户类型"
, cam_scene as "营销场景"
, word_bag_name as "词名/词包名称"
, item_main_id as "宝贝ID/主体ID"
, item_main_name as "宝贝名称/主体名称"
, crowd_name as "人群名称"
, plan_id as "计划ID"
, plan_name as "计划名称"
, province_name as "省份名称"
, ifnull(press_amt,0) as "展现量"
, ifnull(click_amt,0) as "点击量"
, ifnull(cost_amt,0) as "费用金额"
, ifnull(total_barg_amt,0) as "总成交金额"
, ifnull(total_barg_cnt,0) as "总成交笔数"
, ifnull(total_barg_per_cnt,0) as "总成交人数"
, ifnull(barg_new_cust_qty,0) as "成交新客数"
, ifnull(total_cart_qty,0) as "总购物车数"
, ifnull(visit_cnt,0) as "观看次数"
, ifnull(in_store_amt,0) as "进店量"
, ifnull(interact_num,0) as "互动量"
, ifnull(click_ratio,0) as "点击率"
--, ifnull(cpc_amt,0) as "平均点击花费CPC"
--, ifnull(cpm_amt,0) as "千次展现花费CPM"
--, ifnull(roi,0) as "投入产出比ROI"
--, ifnull(conversion_ratio,0) as "转化率"
, ifnull(add_cart_cost,0) as "加购成本"
, ifnull(barg_new_cust_pct,0) as "成交新客占比"
  
  
from dm_ebi_maia_rpa_extent_anl_df

metric.name: CPM
metric.formula: case when SUM([展现量])=0 then 0 else SUM([费用金额])/SUM([展现量]) end

metric.name: ROI
metric.formula: case when SUM([费用金额])=0 then 0 else SUM([总成交金额])/SUM([费用金额]) end

metric.name: 转化率
metric.formula: case when SUM([点击量])=0 then 0 else SUM([总成交笔数])/SUM([点击量]) end

          2、除账户报表和超级直播外其余类型推广只有15天周期统计

columns.name: CPM
columns.formula: case when SUM([展现量])=0 then 0 else (SUM([费用金额])/SUM([展现量]))*1000 end

columns.name: ROI
columns.formula: case when SUM([费用金额])=0 then 0 else SUM([总成交金额])/SUM([费用金额]) end

columns.name: 转化率
columns.formula: case when SUM([点击量])=0 then 0 else SUM([总成交笔数])/SUM([点击量]) end
